name: Annotated Product Spotlight
description: A high-conversion product showcase section using interactive callout lines to highlight specific features directly on a lifestyle image, perfect for complex or wellness-oriented products.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page section featuring a central lifestyle [PRODUCT_IMAGE] showing a person using the product in a natural, comfortable environment. The image should have a soft, cinematic lighting style with a shallow depth of field. Overlay the image with four distinct, minimalist callout points. Each callout consists of a small glowing dot on the product connected by a thin, elegant line to a semi-transparent, frosted glass-style text box containing a feature benefit. The text boxes should be aligned vertically on the right side of the image. At the bottom of the section, place a large, bold, sans-serif [HEADLINE] in white, left-aligned or centered, with high contrast against the background. Include a small, subtle disclaimer text below the headline. The overall aesthetic should be clean, modern, and trustworthy, using a cool-toned color palette (deep blues, soft whites, and subtle neon accents for the callout dots). Ensure the layout is balanced, with ample negative space to allow the product and text to breathe. The design should feel premium, scientific, and approachable, suitable for health, tech, or lifestyle brands.

name: Dramatic Hero Showcase
description: A high-impact, atmospheric hero section featuring a central lifestyle image with product placement in the lower corner, ideal for premium brand storytelling.
prompt: A professional, high-end landing page hero section. The layout features a large, central, high-resolution lifestyle image of a person or subject that dominates the upper two-thirds of the frame, set against a deep, moody, solid-color gradient background. The lighting should be dramatic, emphasizing the subject with soft rim lighting. In the bottom right corner, place the [PRODUCT_IMAGE] clearly, with a subtle reflection on a dark, glossy surface. In the bottom left corner, place the [BRAND_NAME] logo at the top left, and a bold, clean typography block for the [HEADLINE] below it. The typography should use a mix of heavy sans-serif weights for the main headline and a lighter, secondary weight for descriptive subtext. Use a high-contrast color palette where the background is a deep, rich dark tone (like deep purple or charcoal) and the text is crisp white with a single vibrant accent color for key words in the headline. The overall mood is luxurious, sophisticated, and focused on visual storytelling. Ensure ample negative space around the subject to maintain a clean, premium aesthetic. The composition should feel balanced, with the visual weight of the subject centered and the product and text acting as anchors in the lower corners.

name: Feature Control Overlay

prompt: A high-end, professional product landing page section. The layout is perfectly centered. At the very top, place a bold, two-line [HEADLINE] in a clean, modern sans-serif font. Directly below the headline, place a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] vertically centered. Behind the product, incorporate a subtle, glowing circular graphic or clock-like dial element that frames the product, suggesting precision or time-based benefits. The background should be a soft, monochromatic gradient or solid pastel color that complements the product. Surrounding the lower half of the product, arrange four distinct text labels or short benefit phrases in a symmetrical arc or grid pattern. Use a clean, minimalist aesthetic with generous whitespace. The typography should be bold and legible, using a hierarchy where the headline is the largest element, followed by the benefit labels. The overall mood is premium, clinical, and trustworthy. Ensure the lighting on the product is soft and studio-quality, with a subtle drop shadow to create depth against the background. Use a consistent color palette that emphasizes the brand identity of [BRAND_NAME].

name: Asymmetric Product Spotlight
description: A high-impact, asymmetric layout featuring a dominant central product showcase on the left and a vertical stack of three feature-benefit cards on the right, perfect for highlighting multi-step product benefits.
prompt: A high-conversion landing page section design. The layout is split into two main areas: a large left-hand side and a vertical three-row stack on the right. The left side features a large, high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] as the primary focal point, positioned against a soft, monochromatic background. Large, bold, sans-serif typography [HEADLINE] is layered behind or around the product to create depth. The right side is divided into three equal horizontal segments, each containing a small lifestyle image of the product in use, a concise sub-headline, and a short descriptive text. The visual hierarchy is clear: the left side commands attention with the product, while the right side provides educational context. Use a consistent, soft color palette with high-contrast accent colors for text to ensure readability. The overall style is clean, modern, and professional, suitable for premium e-commerce. Include subtle drop shadows on the product image to lift it from the background. Ensure generous whitespace between the right-hand cards to maintain a breathable, organized look. The design should feel cohesive, with the [BRAND_NAME] logo subtly placed in the top corner of each section.

name: Glassmorphism Feature Showcase
description: A sleek, modern product showcase section using glassmorphism cards to highlight key specifications alongside a prominent product image.
prompt: A high-end, professional product landing page section. The layout is split: on the right, a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] is positioned to bleed off the edge of the frame, creating a sense of depth. On the left, a vertical stack of semi-transparent, frosted-glass (glassmorphism) cards with soft white borders and subtle drop shadows. Each card contains a bold, large-font metric or feature headline followed by a smaller, descriptive sub-headline and a minimalist icon. At the top, a large, clean [HEADLINE] serves as the section title. A small, pill-shaped badge with a subtle background color sits near the product to denote a variant or category. The background is a soft, neutral gradient that provides high contrast for the glass cards. The typography is modern, sans-serif, and highly legible. The overall aesthetic is clean, premium, and tech-focused, with generous whitespace and balanced alignment. Use a professional color palette that complements the [PRODUCT_IMAGE]. The lighting should be soft and studio-quality, emphasizing the product's form and the depth of the glass layers.

name: Staggered Feature Showcase
description: A dynamic, multi-row layout featuring alternating text and image blocks with integrated text-based background accents, perfect for highlighting product benefits.
prompt: A high-conversion landing page section featuring a three-row staggered layout. Each row contains a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] of a person using the product, paired with a bold [HEADLINE] and a descriptive sub-headline. The layout alternates the position of the image and text blocks between left and right sides to create visual rhythm. Use a soft, monochromatic color palette with varying shades of a single hue for the background blocks to create depth. Include a subtle, repeating text-based decorative element (like a brand slogan) running horizontally across the background of each row in a lighter, semi-transparent font. Typography should be clean, modern, and high-contrast: large, bold sans-serif headers and smaller, legible body text. Ensure generous whitespace between rows to maintain a clean, premium aesthetic. The overall mood should be lifestyle-oriented, aspirational, and professional. The design must be adaptable to any industry, focusing on clear visual hierarchy where the product usage is the primary focal point, followed by the benefit-driven headline.

name: Promotional Hero Banner
description: A high-impact promotional hero section featuring a centered headline, a prominent coupon code box, and a product cluster resting on a pedestal against a sky-themed background.
prompt: A high-conversion promotional hero section design. The background is a clean, bright, airy sky-blue gradient with soft clouds, evoking a fresh and premium mood. In the center, a large, bold, sans-serif headline [HEADLINE] is displayed in white, with a secondary sub-headline below it. Directly underneath, place a distinct, rectangular white call-to-action box containing a bold, high-contrast coupon code. Below this, position a group of [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items arranged artistically on a clean, minimalist, light-grey geometric pedestal or platform. The products should be sharp, well-lit, and professional, casting soft, realistic shadows onto the platform. The overall composition is vertically centered and symmetrical. Use a clean, modern, high-legibility sans-serif typeface for all text. The bottom of the section should feature a small, subtle, single-line brand name [BRAND_NAME] in a clean, elegant font. The design should feel spacious, professional, and focused on driving immediate sales through a clear offer. High resolution, studio lighting, commercial photography style, clean UI layout.

name: Asymmetric Product Proof
description: A high-conversion product showcase section featuring a large, partially cropped product image on the left and bold, data-driven social proof text on the right.
prompt: A clean, modern landing page section design. The layout is split into two distinct zones. On the left, place a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] that is vertically oriented and slightly cropped at the top and bottom to create a sense of scale and immersion. The background behind the product should feature a soft, abstract, out-of-focus color wash or macro texture that complements the product's primary color. On the right side, against a clean white background, display the [HEADLINE] in a large, bold, sans-serif typeface. Below the headline, feature a prominent, oversized percentage or key metric (e.g., '90%') in a heavy font weight, followed by a clear, readable paragraph of supporting text explaining the benefit. Use a strict visual hierarchy: the product image acts as the primary focal point, while the large metric serves as the secondary focal point. Typography should be professional, minimalist, and highly legible. Include small, subtle footnote text at the bottom right for credibility. The overall aesthetic should be clinical, premium, and trustworthy, with generous whitespace to ensure the content breathes. Use a high-contrast color palette where the product's brand color is used sparingly for accents or text highlights, while the rest of the text remains in deep charcoal or black.

name: Immersive Brand Hero
description: A high-impact, full-bleed hero section featuring a lifestyle image at the top and a product-focused composition at the bottom, perfect for lifestyle-driven e-commerce brands.
prompt: A high-conversion, full-bleed landing page hero section. The layout is vertically stacked with a clear visual hierarchy. The top half features a high-quality lifestyle image of a person interacting with [PRODUCT_IMAGE] in a bright, aspirational setting. The middle section contains a bold, centered text block: a small, elegant sub-headline above a large, high-impact [HEADLINE] in a modern sans-serif typeface, followed by the [BRAND_NAME] logo. The bottom half of the section features a professional, studio-lit product arrangement of multiple [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items against a solid, monochromatic background that matches the brand's primary color palette. The lighting is soft and flattering, creating a cohesive, premium aesthetic. Use generous whitespace between the text and the product cluster to ensure readability. The overall mood is vibrant, clean, and professional. The color scheme should be monochromatic or analogous, utilizing high-contrast text for legibility. Include subtle decorative elements like soft light flares or water droplets at the base to add texture and depth. The design should feel balanced, symmetrical, and optimized for mobile-first viewing.

name: Asymmetric Organic Hero
description: A modern, friendly hero section featuring a high-quality human-centric image on the right and bold, left-aligned typography with organic background shapes.
prompt: A professional landing page hero section with a clean, light-colored background. The layout is split into two main areas: the right side features a high-quality, engaging portrait or lifestyle [PRODUCT_IMAGE] that is slightly cropped or integrated into the composition. The left side contains a bold, large-scale [HEADLINE] using a modern sans-serif typeface, followed by a concise sub-headline paragraph. Use soft, organic, rounded abstract shapes in the background in a muted accent color to create depth and visual interest. Include a small, pill-shaped badge or tag element for dates or key highlights. At the bottom, include a clean footer area with a placeholder for [BRAND_NAME] logo, a contact icon with a phone number, and a small block of descriptive text. The overall aesthetic should be friendly, approachable, and high-end. Use a color palette of soft neutrals for the background, a deep, high-contrast color for the primary text, and a muted, harmonious accent color for the organic shapes and UI elements. Maintain generous whitespace to ensure the design feels airy and premium. High resolution, vector-style UI elements, professional photography style.

name: Radial Product Spotlight
description: A high-conversion product showcase section featuring a central product image surrounded by a radial grid of key benefits, perfect for highlighting technical specifications or unique selling points.
prompt: A professional, high-conversion landing page section featuring a central [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed prominently in the middle. The background is a soft, monochromatic gradient with subtle abstract geometric or organic shapes to add depth. Surrounding the central product is a semi-circular or radial layout divided into five distinct segments, each containing a short, punchy text block highlighting a key feature or benefit. The visual hierarchy is centered on the product, with the surrounding text segments acting as supporting information. Use a clean, modern sans-serif typography for the text blocks, ensuring high readability against the background. Include a small, circular badge or call-out element in the upper left or right corner to highlight a specific certification or origin. The color palette should be cohesive, using a primary brand color for the radial segments and a contrasting, lighter shade for the background to ensure the product pops. The overall style is clean, premium, and informative, suitable for e-commerce or health and beauty products. Ensure the layout is symmetrical and balanced, with generous whitespace between the product and the surrounding text segments to maintain a high-end, uncluttered aesthetic.

name: Typographic Product Collage
description: A high-impact promotional section that blends large-scale background typography with floating product imagery, perfect for seasonal campaigns or product highlights.
prompt: A high-end, professional landing page section featuring a monochromatic or duotone background with a soft radial gradient. The central focus is a large, bold, sans-serif [HEADLINE] text set in a massive, semi-transparent or light-colored font that spans the background. Arrange multiple [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items at dynamic, floating angles across the canvas, interacting with the typography by overlapping or sitting behind the letters to create depth. Use soft drop shadows under the products to give them a 3D, floating effect. The overall composition should feel balanced but energetic. Include a subtle, pill-shaped CTA button at the bottom center with a clean, minimalist label. The color palette should be harmonious, using shades of a single color family to maintain a premium, cohesive look. The lighting should be soft and studio-quality, highlighting the textures of the products. The design should be clean, modern, and visually arresting, suitable for high-conversion e-commerce marketing.

name: Soft Focus Hero
description: A vertical-oriented hero section featuring a human subject interacting with a product, ideal for beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brands.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page hero section with a soft, clean aesthetic. The layout features a central human subject smiling warmly, positioned in the lower half of the frame, interacting with [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed in the foreground. The background is a smooth, gradient-filled surface in a soft, calming color palette, featuring subtle abstract circular light bokeh or liquid-like organic shapes to create depth. At the top, place a bold, high-contrast [HEADLINE] in a modern, elegant serif or sans-serif font. Below the headline, include a pill-shaped badge with a solid background color containing a short, punchy benefit statement. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the human face and the product, using soft studio lighting to create a premium, trustworthy feel. The overall composition should be balanced, with generous negative space at the top for the text and a clear focal point on the product. Use a professional, clean, and minimalist design style suitable for high-end e-commerce. Ensure the lighting on the subject matches the soft, diffused background glow.

name: Centered Brand Spotlight
description: A high-impact, centered promotional section featuring a prominent image container, a circular badge overlay, and clear typography, perfect for event announcements or brand highlights.

Inside this container, display a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] showing people or a product. Overlaid on the lower portion of the image container, place a circular badge with a centered icon or logo. Below the container, place a bold, elegant [HEADLINE] in a large, high-contrast serif or sans-serif font, followed by a concise sub-headline. At the bottom of the section, include a horizontal, pill-shaped footer bar containing small, clean icons for contact information, social media handles, and a website URL. name: High-Impact Promotional Hero

Below the headline, a secondary horizontal banner displays key promotional offers (e.g., discounts, vouchers) using clean, high-contrast typography and simple, minimalist icons. In the center, a dynamic, floating arrangement of [PRODUCT_IMAGE] is displayed, emerging from a branded gift box or container, creating a sense of excitement and abundance. The lighting on the products is bright and professional, with soft highlights. The overall aesthetic is celebratory, premium, and urgent, utilizing a warm color palette of deep reds, gold accents, and clean white text to ensure maximum readability and visual impact. name: Ethereal Product Hero
description: A high-impact, atmospheric product showcase section that uses organic background elements and soft lighting to create a premium, sensory-focused brand experience.
prompt: A high-end, professional product photography landing page section. The composition features a central, sharp, high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed on a clean, flat surface. The background is a soft, monochromatic gradient or solid color that complements the product, featuring large, out-of-focus organic elements like flower petals or abstract shapes that frame the product and create depth. The lighting is soft, diffused, and studio-quality, with subtle highlights on the product to emphasize texture and premium quality. At the top, place the [BRAND_NAME] in a sophisticated, elegant serif typeface. Below the product, include a bold, clean [HEADLINE] in a modern sans-serif font, positioned for high readability. At the very bottom, add a concise, readable paragraph of body text describing the product benefits. The overall mood is luxurious, serene, and minimalist. Use a color palette that is harmonious and monochromatic, with high-contrast text for legibility. Ensure the composition feels balanced, with ample negative space around the product to allow it to breathe. The style should be suitable for beauty, wellness, or premium lifestyle brands, focusing on sensory appeal and visual storytelling.

name: Floating Product Hero
description: A high-impact, vertical-oriented hero section featuring floating product elements against a textured, ethereal background, perfect for premium product launches.
prompt: A professional, high-end landing page hero section. The layout is centered and vertical. The background features a soft, ethereal light-blue gradient with subtle vertical line textures and floating abstract geometric shapes or ribbons to create depth. At the top, place a large, bold, sans-serif [BRAND_NAME] title, followed by a smaller, elegant sub-headline. Below this, include a pill-shaped, semi-transparent glassmorphism badge containing the [HEADLINE] text. The central focal point is a dynamic arrangement of [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items, positioned as if floating in mid-air, with soft drop shadows to ground them. Ensure ample whitespace around the text elements to maintain readability and a clean, uncluttered aesthetic. High-resolution, studio-quality lighting with soft reflections on the product surfaces.

name: Monochromatic Product Hero
description: A high-impact, color-coordinated product showcase section that uses a solid background and overlapping product elements to create a premium, editorial feel.
prompt: A professional, high-conversion landing page hero section. The background is a solid, soft pastel color that sets the mood. In the upper left corner, place a small, clean brand logo [BRAND_NAME]. Below the logo, include a small, high-contrast 'New' badge followed by a large, bold, multi-line [HEADLINE] in a heavy, sans-serif font. The typography should be left-aligned, using a mix of bold and regular weights to create visual hierarchy. The right side and lower half of the frame feature [PRODUCT_IMAGE] arranged in an artistic, overlapping composition. The product should appear to be interacting with abstract, soft-focus textures or powder-like elements that match the background color palette. Use soft, studio-quality lighting to create subtle shadows beneath the products, giving them a sense of depth and realism. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and minimalist, with generous whitespace. Ensure the color palette is monochromatic or analogous to maintain a cohesive, high-end look. The composition should feel balanced, with the text drawing the eye first, followed by the product imagery.

name: Asymmetric Product Hero
description: A high-impact hero section featuring a human subject interacting with a product, balanced by bold typography and floating UI elements, ideal for beauty or lifestyle product launches.
prompt: A professional, high-conversion landing page hero section. The layout is asymmetric: on the right side, a high-quality, well-lit portrait of a person holding or interacting with [PRODUCT_IMAGE] in the foreground. The background is a clean, soft-focus studio setting with a subtle gradient or abstract geometric shapes that complement the brand color palette. On the left side, place a large, bold [HEADLINE] in a modern, sans-serif typeface, using a heavy weight for impact. Include a floating circular badge or 'callout' element near the product to highlight a key feature or specification. Below the product, include a small, clean text block for product details and pricing. The overall visual hierarchy prioritizes the person's face and the product label. Use generous whitespace to keep the design feeling premium and uncluttered. The color scheme should be harmonious, using a primary brand color for accents (like the badge or text highlights) against a neutral or soft-tinted background. Ensure the lighting is soft and flattering, typical of high-end advertising photography. The bottom of the section should feature a clean, horizontal bar containing brand contact info and social/marketplace icons, maintaining a professional and trustworthy aesthetic.

name: Asymmetric Product Hero
description: A high-impact hero section featuring a large product shot on a pedestal alongside a human subject, perfect for lifestyle-oriented product marketing.
prompt: A professional, high-conversion landing page hero section. The layout is asymmetric: on the left, place a large, high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] resting on a clean, minimalist cylindrical pedestal. On the right, feature a high-quality, warm-toned portrait of a person interacting with the product or looking towards the camera, with soft, natural lighting. The background should be a soft, gradient-based aesthetic that complements the product colors, featuring subtle, abstract, flowing organic shapes or light flares to create depth. Position the [HEADLINE] in the upper left quadrant using bold, high-contrast typography that is easy to read against the background. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the headline first, followed by the product, then the human element. Use a sophisticated color palette that balances the product's primary brand colors with neutral, soft tones. Ensure generous whitespace around the text to maintain a premium feel. The overall mood should be aspirational, clean, and trustworthy. Include a subtle shadow beneath the pedestal to ground the product. The composition should feel balanced despite the asymmetry, with the human subject's gaze subtly directing attention toward the product.

name: Promotional Product Showcase
description: A high-conversion promotional banner featuring a hero product image, bold discount typography, and a secondary grid for additional product offers.
prompt: A professional, high-conversion e-commerce promotional banner design. The layout is split into two main sections: a top hero area and a bottom product grid. The top section features a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] on the right side, with a clean, soft-toned background. On the left, place a bold [HEADLINE] in a large, modern sans-serif font, followed by smaller secondary text for offer details and dates. Use a sophisticated, minimalist color palette with high contrast for the discount percentage. The bottom section is a distinct, slightly darker-toned horizontal bar containing a secondary grid of two smaller product cards. Each card should display a product thumbnail, a product name, and a price comparison showing the original price with a strikethrough and the new discounted price in a bold, prominent font. Include a small 'NEW' badge on the hero product. The overall aesthetic should be clean, editorial, and premium, with generous whitespace, balanced alignment, and a professional studio lighting feel. Ensure the typography is crisp and legible, using a mix of heavy weights for prices and light weights for descriptive text.

name: Asymmetric Split Showcase
description: A high-contrast, split-screen layout featuring a large product image on one side and bold typography with feature callouts on the other, perfect for premium product highlights.
prompt: A professional, high-conversion landing page section with a 50/50 vertical split layout. The left side features a clean, high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] isolated on a white background, positioned to slightly overlap the center divide. The right side has a solid dark charcoal or black background. On the right, place a bold, sans-serif [HEADLINE] in large white uppercase letters, with a smaller, elegant sub-headline above it in a contrasting light grey. Below the headline, include two distinct feature callout modules: each module consists of a small, clean icon or secondary product detail image on the left, paired with a short, punchy descriptive text in white on the right, enclosed in a soft-edged, rounded rectangular container with a subtle white border. The overall visual hierarchy prioritizes the product image as the focal point, followed by the bold headline. Use generous whitespace around the text elements to ensure readability. The style should be modern, minimalist, and premium, with sharp edges and high-contrast color blocking. Ensure the lighting on the product is studio-quality with soft shadows to ground it on the white surface. The design should feel balanced, professional, and suitable for high-end e-commerce.

name: Asymmetric Value Proposition
description: A high-conversion section featuring a prominent human-centric image on the right and a value-driven list with a clear CTA on the left, perfect for service-based businesses.
prompt: A professional landing page section design with an asymmetric layout. The background is a deep, solid color with subtle floating abstract elements related to the industry. On the right side, place a high-quality, professional portrait of a person representing the service provider, cropped from the waist up, looking directly at the camera with a friendly expression. On the left side, create a rounded-corner container with a contrasting lighter background color. Inside this container, place a bold, large-scale [HEADLINE] in a clean, modern sans-serif font. Below the headline, include a vertical list of three key benefits, each preceded by a simple, bold icon. Each benefit should have a short title in uppercase and a brief descriptive sentence. At the bottom of the container, include a prominent, pill-shaped call-to-action button with an arrow icon. At the very bottom of the entire section, include a horizontal footer bar with contact details, social media icons, and location information, styled with high legibility. The overall visual hierarchy should guide the eye from the headline to the benefits, then to the CTA. Use a professional color palette with high contrast between the background and the content container. Ensure ample whitespace and clean, balanced alignment.

name: High-Energy Promo Hero
description: A high-impact, centered promotional hero section featuring a dynamic product cluster and bold offer typography, perfect for flash sales and seasonal campaigns.
prompt: A high-energy, professional promotional landing page hero section. The background features a vibrant, radial gradient with light rays emanating from the center to create a sense of urgency and excitement. In the center, a cluster of [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items is arranged in a visually balanced, overlapping composition. Above the products, place a bold, multi-line [HEADLINE] in a heavy, sans-serif typeface with a subtle drop shadow for depth. Below the headline, include a horizontal row of three distinct offer badges or cards, each containing a specific discount or incentive (e.g., percentage off, bundle offer, or voucher value). Floating around the products are stylized, semi-transparent percentage or coupon icons to add a sense of movement. At the bottom center, place a prominent, rounded call-to-action button with a high-contrast color. The overall color palette should be intense and saturated, using a primary brand color for the background and white or light-colored text for maximum readability. The style is clean, commercial, and conversion-focused, with sharp lighting on the products to make them pop against the background. Ensure the layout is symmetrical and balanced, drawing the viewer's eye directly to the product cluster and the primary offer.

name: Annotated Product Callout
description: A high-impact educational section using a large, high-quality hero image with precise callout lines and labels to explain product features or usage steps.
prompt: A clean, modern landing page section featuring a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] occupying the left two-thirds of the frame. The background is a soft, neutral, monochromatic tone. On the right side, overlay a series of four distinct callout points. Each callout consists of a thin, elegant horizontal line extending from a specific point on the product image to a pill-shaped, semi-transparent label containing a bold, uppercase title, followed by a short, readable descriptive paragraph underneath. The typography should be a clean, minimalist sans-serif font with high legibility. The visual hierarchy places the [HEADLINE] in the top right corner in a large, bold, two-line format. The overall aesthetic is editorial, sophisticated, and instructional. Use generous whitespace to ensure the callout lines do not clutter the image. The color palette should be harmonious, using soft earth tones or muted pastels for the background and high-contrast text for the labels. The design should feel professional, educational, and premium, suitable for skincare, tech, or lifestyle products.

name: Sequential Step Showcase
description: A vertical, numbered step-by-step guide that uses large background numerals and alternating product placement to walk users through a multi-part process.
prompt: A high-end, clean landing page section featuring a vertical 3-step process. The background is a soft, solid neutral cream color. At the top, a centered headline [HEADLINE] uses elegant, serif typography with subtle decorative borders around key words. Below, create three distinct steps arranged vertically. Each step features a large, faint, outline-style numeral (1, 2, 3) positioned behind the content as a decorative background element. For each step, place a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] on one side and a descriptive text block on the other, alternating the alignment (left-right-left) for visual rhythm. The text block includes a bold, uppercase sub-header, a concise paragraph of body text, and a small, rectangular solid-color CTA button labeled 'SHOP'. Use a sophisticated color palette: soft cream background, dark charcoal text for readability, and a muted earth-tone accent for the buttons. The overall style is minimalist, editorial, and premium. Ensure generous whitespace between steps to maintain a clean, uncluttered look. The product images should have soft, realistic drop shadows to create depth against the flat background.

The color palette should be harmonious, using a soft, airy background for the portrait and a bold, saturated accent color for the promotional block. Ensure ample whitespace around text elements for readability. The overall mood is premium, aspirational, and conversion-focused, suitable for a high-end e-commerce brand.

name: Split Comparison Showcase

name: Visual Comparison Split

name: Comparative Before-After Split

The left side features a high-resolution [BEFORE_IMAGE] and the right side features a high-resolution [AFTER_IMAGE]. The images are perfectly aligned vertically. Overlaying the images are minimalist, thin white L-shaped corner brackets (cropping markers) at the corners of specific focal areas to draw the eye to the transformation. The text 'BEFORE' is placed in the top-left corner of the left image in a clean, bold, sans-serif white font. The layout should be responsive and balanced, with a subtle vertical divider line between the two halves.

name: Comparative Anatomy Diagram
description: A visual comparison section using 3D isometric models to illustrate a 'before vs. after' or 'problem vs. solution' state, ideal for educational product marketing.
prompt: A high-quality, clean landing page section featuring a side-by-side comparison of two 3D isometric block models placed on a minimalist white pedestal. The left model represents the 'ideal' state and the right model represents the 'degraded' state. Use a soft, monochromatic pastel background to maintain focus on the models. Above each model, place clear, elegant serif text labels. Below the models, use thin, precise leader lines pointing to specific internal components of the 3D models, with labels identifying these parts. Below the pedestal, include a bold, centered primary headline [HEADLINE] in a sophisticated serif font, followed by a smaller, lighter sub-headline and a descriptive body text line. The overall aesthetic should be scientific yet premium, utilizing soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, and a clean, airy composition. The color palette should be harmonious, using soft tones like blush, cream, or light grey. Ensure the visual hierarchy prioritizes the 3D models first, followed by the headline, then the detailed labels. The style should be professional, informative, and visually engaging, suitable for high-end product education.

name: Educational Infographic Diagram
description: A vertical educational diagram using directional arrows and layered cross-sections to explain complex processes or benefits, ideal for scientific or technical product explanations.
prompt: Create a high-quality, professional educational infographic section. The layout is vertical, featuring a large [HEADLINE] at the top center. The background is a clean, soft-gradient sky or neutral environment. The core of the image is a cross-section diagram showing three distinct layers or stages, represented by horizontal bands. From the top, three large, bold, downward-pointing yellow arrows originate from the top of the frame, representing external forces or inputs. Each arrow should have a label and a short descriptive text block attached to it. The arrows should penetrate or interact with the horizontal layers at different depths to illustrate a process. Use a clean, modern sans-serif typography for all labels. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the [HEADLINE] first, then the downward arrows, and finally the descriptive text blocks. The style should be clean, clinical, and highly readable, using a color palette that contrasts the bright, bold arrows against the soft, neutral background. Ensure the cross-section layers are detailed but stylized for clarity. The overall mood is informative, authoritative, and visually engaging, suitable for a landing page explaining how a product works or why a problem exists.

name: Synergy Benefit Diagram
description: A visual educational section that explains how two components combine to create a superior result, ideal for complex product benefits.
prompt: A high-quality, clean landing page section design illustrating a synergistic benefit. The layout features a centered [HEADLINE] at the top, followed by two side-by-side cards representing two distinct components. Each card contains a [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or icon, a bold label, and a short descriptive bullet point with a checkmark icon. Between the two cards, place a prominent plus sign icon. Below these, a downward arrow leads to a large, central, high-fidelity illustration showing the combined effect of the two components. To the right of this central illustration, include a vertical list of three benefit points, each with a small circular icon and descriptive text. The entire section sits on a soft, monochromatic pastel background with subtle light gradients. Use a clean, modern serif font for headings and a legible sans-serif for body text. The visual hierarchy should guide the eye from the top headline, through the two components, down to the combined result, and finally to the specific benefits. Maintain generous whitespace, rounded corners on all containers, and a soft, professional color palette that emphasizes clarity and premium quality.

name: Promotional Comparison Grid
description: A high-conversion promotional section featuring a primary hero offer followed by a vertical list of comparative before-and-after or service-specific cards.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section design. The layout is divided into two main parts: a top hero area and a bottom list area. The top hero area features a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] on the left, with a right-aligned text block containing a [BRAND_NAME] logo, a large, bold [HEADLINE], and a prominent, high-contrast call-to-action button displaying a discounted price alongside a struck-through original price. The bottom area consists of a vertical stack of three white, rounded-corner cards. Each card contains a descriptive title on the left, a price comparison (current vs. original), and a split-screen before-and-after image on the right. The background is a soft, neutral gradient or solid light color to ensure readability. Typography should be modern, sans-serif, and highly legible. Use generous whitespace between cards to create a clean, organized feel. The overall mood is trustworthy, clinical, and premium. Include a thin, subtle footer bar at the very bottom containing contact information and location details with small, simple icons. Ensure the visual hierarchy prioritizes the main offer, followed by the specific service options.

name: Comparative Split Comparison
description: A symmetrical comparison layout featuring a central subject flanked by detailed callouts, ideal for demonstrating 'before vs after' or 'problem vs solution' states.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a symmetrical split-screen comparison layout. In the center, place a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or subject portrait as the primary focal point. Flanking the central image on the left and right sides, create a vertical grid of four circular detail crops each (eight total). The left column represents the 'Problem' state, and the right column represents the 'Solution' state. Each circular crop should have a corresponding short text label underneath describing the specific attribute. Use a thin, elegant vertical line to divide the left and right sides. The background should be a soft, neutral, high-end paper texture. Typography should be sophisticated, using a clean serif font for the main [HEADLINE] at the top and a minimal sans-serif for the descriptive labels. Maintain generous whitespace between elements to ensure a premium, clinical, or editorial feel. The overall color palette should be monochromatic or muted earth tones to emphasize the visual clarity of the comparison. Ensure the visual hierarchy leads the eye from the top headline down through the comparative points, with the central image acting as the anchor.

name: Educational Infographic Split
description: A vertical split-screen layout featuring a high-quality visual anchor on one side and a series of annotated data points on the other, perfect for explaining complex product benefits or comparative scales.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a vertical split layout. On the left side, place a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] that serves as the visual anchor. On the right side, present an educational infographic. Start with a bold, uppercase [HEADLINE] in a dark, high-contrast color. Below the headline, create a vertical list of four distinct data points. Each data point should consist of a bold label and a descriptive sub-text. Use thin, elegant horizontal lines that extend from specific points on the [PRODUCT_IMAGE] to the corresponding text labels on the right, creating a clear visual connection. The background should be a soft, neutral, monochromatic tone to ensure readability. Use a sophisticated, modern sans-serif typography with varying weights to establish a clear visual hierarchy. The overall mood should be clinical, trustworthy, and premium. Ensure generous whitespace between the text elements to maintain a clean, uncluttered aesthetic. Include a small, subtle [BRAND_NAME] logo at the top and a website URL at the bottom center. The design should feel like a high-end educational chart, emphasizing clarity and professional authority.

name: Curved Callout Showcase
description: A high-impact visual section using a curved lead line to connect descriptive text points to a central high-quality subject image, perfect for educational product features.
prompt: A clean, modern landing page section featuring a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or subject portrait on the right side, occupying roughly 50% of the width. On the left side, place a bold [HEADLINE] in a large, sans-serif, high-contrast font. Below the headline, arrange a vertical list of 5 descriptive text points. Connect each text point to a specific area on the subject image using a thin, elegant, black curved arc line that sweeps from the left side of the screen toward the subject. Each text point should be preceded by a small, solid black circular bullet point. The background should be a solid, neutral light gray to ensure maximum readability. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the headline at the top, followed by the subject image, and then the descriptive callouts. Use generous whitespace between the text points to maintain a clean, minimalist aesthetic. The overall style should be professional, editorial, and high-end, suitable for premium brands. Ensure the typography is crisp, with the headline in a heavy weight and the descriptive points in a medium weight.

name: Educational Comparison List
description: A vertical list layout featuring circular visual indicators paired with descriptive text blocks, perfect for educational content or categorization.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a centered [HEADLINE] at the top in a sophisticated serif font. Below the headline, create a vertical list layout. Each row consists of a perfect circle containing a [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or representative icon on the left, followed by a bold category label, and a rounded rectangular text box on the right containing descriptive text. name: Split Comparison Showcase

The layout must feel balanced, professional, and highly informative, emphasizing the transition from the problem on the left to the solution on the right. name: Circular Benefit Diagram

name: Centered Product Hero

name: Data-Driven Benefit Overlay
description: A high-conversion section that overlays key performance metrics and social proof badges directly onto a lifestyle product image, ideal for building trust and authority.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page section featuring a full-width lifestyle [PRODUCT_IMAGE] as the background. The image should be soft-focused or naturally lit to allow for text readability. Overlay a clean, modern typography layout on the lower half of the image. Include a prominent [HEADLINE] in a bold, dark sans-serif font, followed by a descriptive sub-headline. Below the text, arrange three distinct data points in a horizontal row, each consisting of a large, bold percentage or number followed by a short, descriptive caption in a smaller, lighter weight font. To the right, place a circular, high-contrast badge or seal element that highlights a key certification or recommendation. Use a consistent, professional color palette with high-contrast text against the image background. Ensure generous whitespace around the text elements to maintain a clean, premium aesthetic. The overall mood should be trustworthy, scientific, and aspirational. Include a small, subtle footnote at the very bottom of the section for disclaimers. The design should feel balanced, organized, and authoritative, suitable for any premium consumer product.

name: Problem Agitation Grid
description: A visual layout that highlights a primary problem or pain point using a central image and a surrounding circular grid of specific symptoms or use cases.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section design. At the top, place a bold [HEADLINE] in a large, sans-serif font, followed by a smaller, lighter sub-headline. Below this, arrange five circular image thumbnails in a semi-circular or arc formation. Each circular image should depict a specific problem or symptom, with a short descriptive text label centered directly beneath each circle. In the lower half of the section, feature a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] that occupies the width of the container, showing the product in use or in a lifestyle context. The background should be clean white or a very light gradient to maintain focus on the content. Use a high-contrast color scheme for the text, such as deep navy or charcoal. The overall aesthetic should be medical, wellness, or solution-oriented, emphasizing clarity, empathy, and professional trust. Ensure generous whitespace between the circular icons and the main product image to create a balanced visual hierarchy. The design should feel modern, airy, and easy to scan, suitable for any industry highlighting a solution to a specific user pain point.

name: Before-After Proof Section
description: A high-conversion social proof section featuring a before-and-after image comparison paired with a product shot to build immediate trust.
prompt: A clean, minimalist landing page section with a solid, soft-toned background. At the top, place a centered text block: a small, uppercase sans-serif label, followed by a large, elegant serif headline [HEADLINE], and a smaller sub-headline. Below the text, create a horizontal row containing two side-by-side square images with slightly rounded corners, representing a 'before' and 'after' transformation. Below these images, place a high-quality, centered photograph of [PRODUCT_IMAGE] being held by a hand, positioned to overlap slightly with the bottom of the section to create depth. The overall visual hierarchy should prioritize the transformation images, followed by the product. Use a sophisticated, muted color palette with high contrast between the background and the text. Typography should be a mix of modern sans-serif for labels and classic, high-end serif for the main headline. Ensure generous whitespace around all elements to maintain a premium, uncluttered aesthetic. The lighting should be soft and natural, emphasizing the texture of the product and the clarity of the transformation images.

name: Problem-Agitation Infographic Hero
description: A centered, high-impact hero section that uses a central visual with floating callout labels to highlight specific pain points or features, ideal for service-based solutions.
prompt: A professional landing page hero section featuring a centered, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or subject in a clean, modern environment. The layout is vertically centered with a clear visual hierarchy. At the top, place a bold [HEADLINE] in a clean, sans-serif font, followed by a smaller sub-headline. The core of the image features the subject with 3-4 floating, semi-transparent glassmorphism-style callout labels pointing to specific areas of the subject. Each label contains short, punchy text describing a specific pain point or feature. Use a soft, professional color palette with a muted background to ensure the subject and labels pop. The typography should be modern, legible, and high-contrast. At the bottom, include a prominent, rounded CTA button or contact information block that stands out against the background. The overall mood is clinical, trustworthy, and solution-oriented. Ensure generous whitespace around the central subject to maintain a clean, uncluttered look. Use soft, natural lighting to create a premium feel.

name: Problem Agitation Hero
description: A high-contrast, two-column layout designed to highlight a specific pain point or problem on the left and a visual representation of that issue on the right, ideal for service-based businesses.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section with a two-column layout. The left side features a text-heavy area with a clear visual hierarchy: a large, bold [HEADLINE] in a dark, high-contrast color, followed by a medium-weight sub-headline that agitates the problem, and a final call-to-action line. The right side features a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or illustrative image that visually represents the problem or the subject matter, with a soft vignette or fade-out effect at the edges to blend into the background. The background is a clean, light, neutral off-white or soft grey. At the bottom of the section, include a full-width dark footer bar containing contact information and website URL, using simple, clean icons for phone and web. Typography should be sans-serif, modern, and highly legible. The overall mood is clinical, trustworthy, and direct. Ensure generous whitespace around the text block to maintain focus. The design should be balanced, with the image occupying roughly 40-50% of the horizontal space, creating a strong focal point that draws the eye from the headline to the visual representation of the problem.

name: Problem-Solution Hero
description: A high-impact hero section that visually represents a pain point or human experience, paired with a product placement to offer an immediate solution.
prompt: A high-conversion landing page hero section featuring a clean, white background. The composition is centered around a high-quality, emotive human-centric image that illustrates a specific problem or physical sensation, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame. Below this, place a bold, sans-serif [HEADLINE] in a dark, high-contrast color, centered. On the bottom left, place a high-resolution, isolated [PRODUCT_IMAGE] standing upright, casting a soft, realistic drop shadow. The bottom of the section features a solid, vibrant color block that anchors the product and provides a base for the design. The overall style is minimalist, professional, and direct, focusing on the emotional connection between the user's need and the [BRAND_NAME] solution. Use generous whitespace to ensure the focal point remains on the human subject and the product. Typography should be clean, modern, and authoritative. The lighting should be bright and studio-quality, emphasizing clarity and trust. Ensure the layout is balanced, with the product acting as a clear visual anchor against the emotive imagery above.

name: Before After Comparison
description: A high-impact visual comparison section designed to demonstrate product efficacy through a split-screen transformation effect.
prompt: Create a high-conversion landing page section featuring a vertical split-screen comparison. The background is a clean, neutral, soft-toned solid color. The main visual is a single subject split perfectly down the middle by a thin, crisp vertical white line. The left side shows the 'Before' state (dull, unrefined, or problematic), and the right side shows the 'After' state (vibrant, polished, or solved). Positioned in the foreground, centered horizontally and overlapping the bottom third of the split image, is a high-quality, professional product shot of [PRODUCT_IMAGE]. The product should have a slight drop shadow to lift it from the background. Below the split image, place two clean, minimalist text labels: 'BEFORE' on the left and 'THE PROOF' on the right, using a modern, sans-serif, uppercase typeface with wide letter spacing. The overall aesthetic should be premium, clinical yet inviting, and highly focused on visual storytelling. Ensure the lighting on the product is studio-quality with soft highlights. The composition should be balanced, symmetrical, and uncluttered, emphasizing the transformation effect as the primary focal point.

name: Problem Agitation Hub

name: Problem Solution Split

name: Transformation Result Showcase
description: A high-impact visual comparison section that uses a split-image header to demonstrate 'before and after' results, followed by a centered product focus, ideal for beauty, wellness, or home improvement brands.

The top half of the section features a horizontal split-screen layout: the left side shows a 'Before' state image, and the right side shows an 'After' state image, both high-quality, natural lighting, professional photography. Below this, a solid, soft-toned background area serves as the primary content zone. In the center of this area, place a large, bold, sans-serif [HEADLINE] in a dark, high-contrast color. Directly beneath the headline, place a high-resolution, centered [PRODUCT_IMAGE] of the product, standing upright on a clean surface. The overall aesthetic should be minimalist, premium, and airy, with generous whitespace. Use a neutral, sophisticated color palette (e.g., warm beige, soft cream, or light grey). name: Before-After Comparison
description: A high-impact visual comparison section designed to demonstrate the efficacy of a product or service by contrasting a 'problem' state with a 'solution' state.

At the top, center-aligned text includes a small, elegant script-style sub-headline followed by a clear, concise [HEADLINE] in a modern sans-serif font. Below the text, a large, high-resolution split-screen image container displays two distinct states: the left side represents the 'Before' or 'Problem' state, and the right side represents the 'After' or 'Solution' state. The two images are separated by a sharp, thin vertical divider line that creates a clean visual break. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and clinical, using a neutral, soft-toned background (such as light beige or off-white) to ensure the focus remains entirely on the visual transformation. The typography should be highly legible with generous whitespace above and below the text block. The design should feel premium and trustworthy, suitable for skincare, home improvement, or software transformation results. Ensure the lighting in the images is consistent but highlights the contrast between the two states. No clutter, no extra UI elements, just a clean, direct, and persuasive visual narrative.

name: Curved Callout Showcase
description: A high-impact visual section featuring a central subject image with a curved, annotated callout list, perfect for explaining multi-step processes or product benefits.

On the left side, a large, bold [HEADLINE] is placed at the top, using a clean, modern sans-serif typeface. A thin, elegant black arc line curves vertically along the left side of the image, acting as a spine for five evenly spaced circular bullet points. Each bullet point connects to a short, descriptive text label placed to the right of the arc, pointing toward specific areas of the image. The overall aesthetic is minimalist, clinical, and premium, with generous whitespace. The style should be clean, editorial, and highly readable, suitable for high-end e-commerce or service-based landing pages.

name: Educational Comparison Grid

The color palette should be soft, warm, and earthy, ensuring high contrast between the text and the background. Include a small, centered brand identifier [BRAND_NAME] at the very bottom of the section. The design should feel like a high-end editorial layout, emphasizing clarity and visual storytelling.

name: Comparative Result Split
description: A minimalist visual comparison section using a split-screen effect to demonstrate product efficacy or transformation.

The two images are placed adjacent to each other, separated by a thin, crisp vertical line. The images are contained within a custom, organic, wave-like or curved shape mask that gives the comparison a modern, non-rectangular aesthetic. Above the left image, place the text 'BEFORE' in a clean, sans-serif, uppercase font. Below the right image, place the text 'AFTER' in the same style. Maintain generous whitespace around the comparison element to create a premium, clinical, or professional feel. The style should be clean, high-resolution, and suitable for a modern e-commerce or service-based landing page.

name: Split Comparison Hero
