prompt: A professional landing page section design. The layout is a two-column split. On the left, place a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] centered vertically, set against a clean, soft-focus, minimalist background that complements the product. On the right, create a vertical stack of four distinct benefit points. Each point consists of a circular icon container with a thin border and a simple, modern line-art icon inside, followed by a concise, bold text label describing a key benefit. The typography for the main section header [HEADLINE] should be large, bold, and sans-serif, positioned at the top right. Use a high-contrast color scheme where the text and icon strokes are a deep, professional color (like dark forest green or charcoal) against a clean, off-white or light neutral background. Ensure generous whitespace between the benefit rows to maintain readability. The overall aesthetic should be clean, clinical, and premium, suitable for health, beauty, or wellness products. The lighting should be soft and natural, highlighting the product's texture and quality.

name: Asymmetric Product Spotlight
description: A high-conversion product showcase section featuring a central product image against a split-background, followed by a clean, icon-based benefits grid.
prompt: A professional landing page section design. The layout features a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] centered in the upper portion, set against a background split diagonally with a soft, organic curve separating a light cream top section and a deep, muted forest green bottom section. Below the product, place a bold, centered [HEADLINE] in a clean, modern sans-serif typeface. Underneath the headline, create a three-column grid of benefits. Each column contains a minimalist, thin-line vector icon representing a feature, followed by a short, descriptive text label. Use vertical thin-line dividers between the columns to create a structured, organized look. The overall aesthetic is premium, minimalist, and trustworthy. The color palette should utilize high-contrast text (white on dark green, dark grey on cream) to ensure readability. Maintain generous whitespace around all elements to emphasize the product. The style should be clean, editorial, and suitable for high-end e-commerce, focusing on clarity and visual hierarchy.

name: Circular Ingredient Spotlight
description: A visually engaging product showcase that centers a product image surrounded by four distinct feature quadrants, perfect for highlighting key ingredients or benefits.
prompt: A clean, minimalist landing page section featuring a central [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed in the middle of a large, invisible circle. Surrounding the central product are four distinct quadrants, each containing a high-quality circular crop image representing a specific feature or ingredient. The layout is a 2x2 grid structure. Each quadrant has a bold, sans-serif [HEADLINE] title followed by a concise descriptive paragraph underneath. The background is a solid, light neutral color (off-white or soft grey) to ensure high contrast. The typography is modern, clean, and highly legible with a clear hierarchy between the bold headings and the body text. The overall aesthetic is scientific, premium, and organized. Use generous whitespace between the four quadrants to maintain a clean, airy feel. The central product should be the primary focal point, with the surrounding circular images acting as supporting visual context. The design should feel balanced, symmetrical, and professional, suitable for high-end skincare, tech, or wellness products.

name: Floating Feature Spotlight
description: A clean, minimalist product feature section that uses floating imagery and directional typography to highlight key benefits.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist landing page section featuring a clean, soft-gradient light background. At the top center, place a large, bold [HEADLINE] followed by a smaller, lighter sub-headline. Below this, arrange two high-quality, isolated [PRODUCT_IMAGE] elements floating in a staggered, asymmetric composition. Each product image should have a soft, realistic drop shadow to create depth. Position text callouts around the images using a clean, modern sans-serif typeface. Each callout consists of a bold, medium-sized feature title and a smaller, descriptive paragraph underneath, separated by a thin, horizontal accent line. The layout should prioritize negative space, ensuring the text and images feel balanced and airy. Use a professional color palette with a primary dark text color for readability and a secondary accent color for the feature titles to draw the eye. The overall aesthetic should be clinical, premium, and scientific, suitable for high-end skincare or tech products. Ensure the composition is vertically oriented, allowing for clear visual flow from the main headline down through the floating product features.

name: Annotated Product Spotlight
description: A centered product showcase section using hand-drawn arrows to point out key features and benefits, perfect for highlighting specific product attributes.
prompt: A high-quality, professional product photography landing page section. The center of the frame features a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] held by a hand against a solid, vibrant, monochromatic background. The composition is clean and minimalist. Surrounding the product are 6-8 short text labels describing key features, arranged symmetrically on the left and right sides. Each text label is connected to a specific part of the product by a thin, elegant, hand-drawn white arrow. The typography for the labels is clean, modern, sans-serif, and highly legible. At the top center, place a large, bold [HEADLINE] text. The overall aesthetic is modern, clean, and conversion-focused. Use a consistent color palette that complements the product color. Ensure ample whitespace around the product to maintain focus. The lighting should be soft and studio-quality, highlighting the texture and details of the [PRODUCT_IMAGE]. The style should be professional e-commerce marketing, emphasizing clarity and benefit-driven communication.

name: Centralized Benefit Diagram
description: A visual infographic section featuring a central product illustration surrounded by circular benefit callouts, perfect for explaining complex product advantages.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page infographic section. In the center, place a high-quality, stylized illustration of [PRODUCT_IMAGE] being held or used. Surrounding this central focal point, arrange four circular icons or small illustrations in a balanced, radial layout. Each circle should represent a specific benefit or feature of the product. Below each circle, include a short, bold, sans-serif text label for [HEADLINE]. The background should be a soft, solid, light pastel color to ensure high contrast with the central illustration. Use a clean, modern, and friendly aesthetic. The typography should be bold and legible, using a hierarchy where the main section title is at the top, centered, and larger than the benefit labels. The overall style should be vector-art inspired, professional, and educational. Ensure ample whitespace between the central image and the surrounding benefit circles to maintain a clean, uncluttered look. The color palette should be harmonious, using a primary brand color for the circles and text, with a neutral background.

name: Curved Feature Callout
description: A visually engaging section that connects a central subject image to specific feature points via a curved path, perfect for highlighting benefits of a lifestyle or health product.
prompt: A high-quality, modern landing page section featuring a split layout. On the right side, place a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or lifestyle subject within a large, soft-edged circular or organic frame. On the left side, create a vertical list of four distinct feature points. Each feature point consists of a bold title and a descriptive sub-text. Connect each feature point to the central image using a clean, elegant, thin white curved line that flows from the text area to a circular icon container placed along the curve. Inside each circular icon container, place a minimalist, thin-line vector icon representing the feature. The background should be a soft, professional gradient that complements the brand colors. The typography should be clean, sans-serif, and highly legible, with a clear hierarchy between the bold feature titles and the lighter sub-text. Ensure generous whitespace between elements to maintain a premium, uncluttered feel. The overall mood should be aspirational, clean, and informative, suitable for a health, wellness, or lifestyle brand. Use a consistent color palette that allows the white lines and icons to pop against the gradient background.

name: Circular Benefit Orbit
description: A product-centric layout featuring a central or side-positioned product image surrounded by a circular arrangement of benefit icons and descriptive text, ideal for explaining multi-functional products.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page section featuring a central [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed on the left side of the frame. The background is a soft, warm, neutral gradient with subtle light-leak effects to create a premium, clean aesthetic. To the right of the product, arrange five circular white badges in a gentle arc or semi-circle formation. Each circular badge contains a minimalist, thin-line vector icon representing a specific benefit. Directly below each icon, place a short, two-line descriptive text label in a clean, modern sans-serif font. Use elegant, thin, hand-drawn style arrows that curve around the product, visually connecting the product to the benefit icons to suggest a flow of action or transformation. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the product image, followed by the benefit icons. Ensure ample whitespace between the elements to maintain a sophisticated, uncluttered look. The overall mood should be clinical yet inviting, professional, and trustworthy. Use a color palette that complements the product, utilizing high-contrast dark text against the light background for readability. The layout should feel balanced, with the product acting as the anchor point for the surrounding information.

name: Product Benefit Showcase
description: A high-conversion product-centric layout featuring a central product image flanked by icon-led benefit points, ideal for supplements, skincare, or tech gadgets.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed prominently on the left side, sitting on a minimalist circular pedestal. The background is a clean, solid white to ensure maximum focus on the product. To the right of the product, create a vertical list of four distinct benefit points. Each point must consist of a bold, simple line-art icon in a vibrant brand-consistent color, followed by a concise, punchy headline in a clean sans-serif font. The layout should use generous whitespace to create a premium, uncluttered feel. Include subtle, floating decorative elements related to the product's ingredients or essence around the product image to add depth and visual interest. The overall visual hierarchy should lead the eye from the product to the benefits. Use a professional, modern typography style with high contrast between the icon color and the text. The design should feel balanced, trustworthy, and informative, suitable for a high-end e-commerce landing page. Ensure the product image is sharp and well-lit, with soft shadows on the pedestal to ground it in the space.

name: Product Benefit Callout
description: A centered product showcase section featuring a central image surrounded by floating benefit labels connected by directional arrows, perfect for highlighting key product advantages.
prompt: A high-quality, clean landing page section featuring a central [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed on a minimalist white circular pedestal. The background is a soft, neutral split-tone grey. Surrounding the product are six distinct text labels arranged in a balanced, circular layout. Each label is enclosed in a thin, dashed-line rectangular border with rounded corners. Each label is connected to the central product by a hand-drawn style black arrow pointing from the label toward the product. The typography for the [HEADLINE] at the top is bold, high-contrast, and modern, using a mix of elegant serif and clean sans-serif fonts. The overall visual hierarchy places the product as the primary focal point, with the benefit labels acting as secondary information. Use generous whitespace to ensure the design feels airy and premium. Include subtle, soft-focus floral or organic decorative elements in the corners to add a touch of elegance. The lighting should be soft and studio-quality, highlighting the texture and form of the [PRODUCT_IMAGE]. The color palette should be professional and muted, allowing the product to stand out.

name: Scientific Explainer Diagram
description: A vertical, multi-layered infographic section designed to visually explain the mechanism of action or internal structure of a product.
prompt: A clean, professional, high-quality 3D scientific infographic section on a soft gradient background. The central focus is a vertical, exploded-view diagram showing [PRODUCT_IMAGE] interacting with multiple distinct layers of a surface or system. The layers should be stacked vertically with subtle spacing between them to show depth. Use clear, thin leader lines extending from each layer to the left and right sides of the image. On the ends of these leader lines, place clean, sans-serif text labels for [HEADLINE] and descriptive sub-text. Use a soft, professional color palette with a light blue or neutral gradient background. The style should be clinical, educational, and modern, utilizing soft lighting, smooth 3D rendering, and high-contrast, legible typography. Include a prominent, rounded-corner highlight badge for the primary active ingredient or feature. Ensure the visual hierarchy guides the eye from the top layer down to the bottom layer, using subtle arrows or flow indicators to show movement or interaction. The overall aesthetic should be trustworthy, scientific, and easy to understand, suitable for a high-end landing page.

name: Circular Product Spotlight
description: A focused product showcase section featuring a central circular product image surrounded by three distinct feature icons, ideal for highlighting key benefits of a single item.
prompt: A high-conversion landing page section design. The background is a solid, vibrant, monochromatic color with a subtle radial gradient for depth. In the upper center, place a large, bold [HEADLINE] in a clean, sans-serif, white typeface. Directly below the headline, position a large, perfectly circular frame containing the [PRODUCT_IMAGE], featuring a soft drop shadow to make it pop from the background. Below the circular product image, arrange three distinct, minimalist white line-art icons in a fan-like layout. Each icon should be paired with a short, descriptive text label underneath it, using a clean, legible sans-serif font. The overall layout should be symmetrical and balanced, emphasizing the product as the primary focal point. Use generous whitespace between the product circle and the feature icons to maintain a clean, premium aesthetic. The color palette should be monochromatic, using different shades of the same hue to create contrast between the background, the circular frame, and the text elements. The style should be modern, clean, and professional, suitable for e-commerce or health and wellness products.

name: Data Visualization Hero
description: A clean, centered section featuring a bold headline above a graphical data visualization, perfect for demonstrating product efficacy or market trends.
prompt: A high-quality, minimalist landing page section with a soft, light-toned gradient background. At the top, place a bold, multi-line [HEADLINE] in a clean, modern sans-serif font, using a primary brand color for emphasis. Below the headline, center a clean, professional data chart or graph inside a rounded-corner container with a subtle drop shadow. The chart should feature two distinct, elegant trend lines (one solid, one dashed) representing data progression over time. Integrate a circular [PRODUCT_IMAGE] cutout directly into the chart area, connected by a subtle pointer or callout line to a specific data point. Use thin, light-gray grid lines for the chart background. Below the chart, include clear, evenly spaced labels for time intervals or categories. The overall aesthetic should be clinical, trustworthy, and premium. Use generous whitespace around all elements to ensure readability. The color palette should be monochromatic or analogous, focusing on soft pastels with a darker, high-contrast color for the data lines and text. Ensure the layout is balanced, symmetrical, and visually uncluttered, suitable for a professional brand presentation.

name: Annotated Feature Callout
description: A clean, vertical feature list section that uses a large, partially-overlapping product image on the right to anchor the visual hierarchy, ideal for explaining product benefits.
prompt: A high-end, clean landing page section design. The layout features a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] positioned on the right side, slightly bleeding off the edge of the container. To the left, a bold, centered [HEADLINE] sits at the top. Below the headline, a vertical list of four distinct feature points. Each feature point consists of a minimalist, thin-line vector icon on the far left, followed by a short, punchy text description. Horizontal divider lines separate each feature row, extending from the icon area to the edge of the product image. The design uses a soft, monochromatic or light pastel background with high-contrast, elegant typography. The visual hierarchy is clear: the headline draws the eye first, followed by the product image, then the feature list. Use generous whitespace between elements to create a premium, airy feel. The style should be modern, professional, and minimalist, suitable for beauty, wellness, or high-end consumer goods. Ensure the color palette is cohesive, using a primary brand color for icons and text, and a neutral background.

name: Timeline Benefit Showcase
description: A vertical timeline-based feature section that maps product benefits to specific time intervals, perfect for demonstrating efficacy or usage duration.
prompt: A high-conversion landing page section featuring a vertical timeline layout on a solid, vibrant background. On the right side, place a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] at a slight tilt, featuring a circular cutout overlay that highlights a specific detail of the product. On the left side, create a vertical dashed line acting as a timeline path. Along this path, place three distinct horizontal pill-shaped containers with rounded corners, each containing a time-based label (e.g., '60 minutes', '2 hours', 'Overnight'). Below each pill, place a short, bold text description of the benefit associated with that timeframe. Use a clean, modern sans-serif typography with high contrast against the background. The overall visual hierarchy should guide the eye from the top-left timeline down to the product image on the right. Include a subtle hand-drawn arrow pointing from the bottom of the timeline toward the product to create a cohesive flow. The style should be minimalist, professional, and persuasive, using a monochromatic or complementary color palette that emphasizes the product's primary color. Ensure ample whitespace between elements to maintain readability and a premium feel.

name: Annotated Product Callout
description: A technical product showcase section featuring a central hero image with multiple circular detail callouts connected by thin lines, ideal for highlighting specific features of complex physical products.
prompt: A clean, professional product landing page section. In the center, place a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] on a clean white background. To the right of the product, arrange a vertical stack of four circular inset images, each showing a zoomed-in detail or specific feature of the product. Use thin, crisp grey lines to connect each circular inset to the corresponding part of the main product image. Next to each circular inset, place a bold, sans-serif feature title [HEADLINE] followed by a short, concise descriptive paragraph in a smaller, lighter font weight. At the top left, include a large, bold section header. The overall layout should be spacious with generous white space to ensure readability. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the main product image, followed by the feature callouts. Use a professional, minimalist aesthetic with a neutral color palette, allowing the product colors to pop. Ensure the typography is modern, clean, and highly legible. The style should be clinical, informative, and high-end, suitable for e-commerce or technical product documentation.

name: Scientific Benefit Breakdown
description: A clean, educational section that uses a central icon or molecule graphic flanked by two circular visual representations to explain complex product benefits.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist landing page section designed for educational product storytelling. The layout is vertically centered with a clean, off-white textured paper background. At the top, place a [HEADLINE] in a sophisticated, elegant serif font, followed by a thin horizontal divider line. Below the divider, position a central, high-quality 3D icon or scientific illustration representing the core technology or ingredient. Directly beneath this, place two circular image frames side-by-side, separated by a subtle plus sign icon. Each circle should contain a high-resolution visual representation of a specific benefit or result. Below each circle, include a short, clean sans-serif label describing the benefit. Add a second thin horizontal divider line below these elements. At the bottom, place a concluding summary sentence in an italicized serif font. The overall visual hierarchy should be balanced and symmetrical, utilizing generous whitespace to create a premium, clinical, and trustworthy aesthetic. Use a muted, professional color palette with soft shadows and high-contrast typography to ensure readability. The style should feel like a high-end editorial magazine or a premium skincare brand's educational module.

name: Data Visualization Hero
description: A centered, educational section that uses a graphical chart to illustrate a problem-solution narrative, perfect for science-backed or performance-oriented products.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a centered layout. At the top, place a bold, multi-line [HEADLINE] in a sophisticated sans-serif font. Below the headline, center a large, soft-edged rectangular container with a light pastel background. Inside this container, display a clean, minimalist line graph on a subtle grid. The graph should feature two distinct, contrasting colored lines representing data trends, with clear labels at the end of each line. Integrate a circular cutout or 'callout' bubble containing [PRODUCT_IMAGE] that points to a specific intersection on the graph, emphasizing the product's impact. Use a soft, gradient background for the entire section to create depth. The typography should be elegant and highly readable. The overall aesthetic should be clinical yet premium, using a color palette of soft neutrals, muted pastels, and two high-contrast accent colors for the graph lines. Ensure generous whitespace around the chart container to maintain a clean, uncluttered look. The design should feel trustworthy, data-driven, and modern.

name: Radial Benefit Showcase
description: A circular, multi-segment layout that radiates from a central product image to highlight key benefits, perfect for explaining complex product features.
prompt: A high-conversion product landing page section featuring a central [PRODUCT_IMAGE] as the primary focal point. The layout is a large, perfect circle divided into three distinct radial segments or 'pie slices' that emanate from the center. Each segment contains a high-quality lifestyle image related to the benefit, overlaid with a semi-transparent color tint that matches the brand identity. Within each segment, place a [HEADLINE] using a combination of elegant, handwritten-style script for emphasis and bold, clean sans-serif typography for the core message. The central [PRODUCT_IMAGE] should be slightly oversized, appearing to float above the circular segments with a subtle drop shadow to create depth. The background should be a soft, solid, or very subtle gradient color that complements the brand palette. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and educational, focusing on visual storytelling. Ensure the text is highly legible against the tinted imagery. The composition should feel balanced and symmetrical, with generous whitespace around the circular element to keep the focus on the product and its benefits. Use professional studio lighting effects on the product to make it pop.

name: Minimalist Testimonial Card
description: A clean, centered testimonial card featuring a star rating, product identifier, quote, and author signature, perfect for building social proof.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist testimonial card centered on a soft, neutral background with subtle organic shadow overlays. The card is a clean white rectangle with a slight drop shadow to create depth. At the top center of the card, place a row of five vibrant gold star icons. Directly below the stars, display the [PRODUCT_NAME] in a bold, dark grey sans-serif font. Below that, center a multi-line customer testimonial quote in a readable, medium-weight serif or sans-serif font. At the bottom of the card, include the author's name in a delicate, elegant script font. The overall composition should be highly symmetrical and balanced, with generous white space inside the card to ensure readability. The background should be clean and uncluttered, focusing all visual attention on the testimonial content. Use a professional, modern aesthetic suitable for any e-commerce or service-based landing page. High resolution, sharp typography, clean lines, soft lighting.

name: Floating Testimonial Card
description: A centered, elevated testimonial card featuring a circular portrait and star rating, ideal for building trust and social proof on landing pages.
prompt: A high-quality, clean landing page testimonial section. The layout features a large, soft-cornered, light-colored rectangular card centered on a subtle, professional background image of a workspace. At the top center of the card, a circular portrait [PRODUCT_IMAGE] is partially overlapping the top edge, framed with a thick white border. Inside the card, display the [HEADLINE] as a centered, readable paragraph of testimonial text. Below the text, include the name of the reviewer in a small, uppercase, sans-serif font. At the very bottom of the card, place a row of five solid black star icons representing a five-star rating. The design should emphasize high contrast between the card and the background, using generous whitespace inside the card to ensure readability. The overall aesthetic is modern, professional, and trustworthy, suitable for any service-based business. Use a clean, minimalist typography style. The background should be slightly blurred or desaturated to keep the focus on the testimonial card.

name: Floating Social Proof
description: A dynamic, asymmetrical testimonial section featuring floating review cards around a central brand icon, perfect for building trust and community engagement.
prompt: A clean, modern landing page section featuring a soft off-white background. In the center, place a prominent, rounded-square brand icon or logo placeholder [BRAND_NAME] decorated with three small, vibrant red heart icons floating around it. Surrounding this central element, arrange four distinct, soft-white, rounded-rectangle testimonial cards in an asymmetrical, staggered layout. Each card should contain a user avatar placeholder, a name, a timestamp, a five-star rating row in gold, and a short text block [HEADLINE]. The cards should have a subtle drop shadow to create a floating effect. Below the floating elements, include a centered, friendly, and appreciative text block expressing gratitude to customers. The overall aesthetic should be minimalist, airy, and approachable, using generous whitespace to separate the cards. The typography should be clean, sans-serif, and highly readable. The design should feel organic and non-grid-based, emphasizing a social, community-driven vibe. High-quality UI design, soft lighting, professional web layout.

name: Glassmorphism Testimonial Card
description: A centered, glass-effect testimonial card overlaying a soft-focus background, perfect for building trust through social proof.
prompt: A high-quality landing page section featuring a centered testimonial card with a frosted glass (glassmorphism) effect. The background is a soft-focus, desaturated lifestyle image with a subtle dark overlay to ensure readability. The central card has rounded corners, a semi-transparent white background, and a soft drop shadow. Inside the card, place a circular user avatar at the top, followed by the user's name in bold, sans-serif typography, and their location in a smaller, lighter font. Below this, include a row of five bright yellow star icons representing a 5-star rating. At the bottom of the card, include a multi-line testimonial quote in a clean, readable sans-serif font. The overall aesthetic should be modern, clean, and professional. Use generous padding inside the card to create breathing room. The layout should be perfectly centered on the page. The color palette should be neutral with high-contrast text and vibrant accents for the star ratings. The design should feel premium and trustworthy, suitable for any brand or service.

name: Floating Social Proof
description: A high-impact product showcase section featuring a central product image surrounded by floating, semi-transparent customer review cards to build immediate trust.
prompt: A high-quality, vertical landing page section featuring a centered [PRODUCT_IMAGE] held by a hand against a solid, vibrant, high-contrast background color. The product is the clear focal point. Surrounding the product are 5-6 floating, rounded-corner white review cards arranged in an organic, staggered layout. Each card contains a small circular user avatar, a five-star rating in gold, and a short, punchy customer testimonial in clean, sans-serif typography. Above the product, place the [BRAND_NAME] in a minimalist, uppercase font, followed by a large, elegant, serif-style [HEADLINE] that feels authoritative and inviting. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and social-media-inspired. Use generous whitespace to ensure the floating cards do not overlap the product too heavily. The lighting should be bright and natural, casting soft shadows under the floating cards to create a sense of depth and layering. The composition should feel balanced, airy, and premium, suitable for high-conversion e-commerce pages.

name: Floating Testimonial Collage
description: A dynamic social proof section featuring a blurred background image of a professional or product with floating, layered testimonial cards, perfect for building trust and humanizing a brand.
prompt: A high-quality landing page section design featuring a soft-focus, blurred background image of a professional at work or a high-end product, creating a clean, atmospheric backdrop. Overlaid on this background are multiple floating, semi-transparent white testimonial cards arranged in a staggered, asymmetric layout. Each card contains a user avatar, a name, a timestamp, a 5-star rating in gold, and a paragraph of [HEADLINE] text. The cards should have subtle drop shadows to create depth and separation from the background. Include a small, decorative icon like a heart or a brand-related symbol floating near one of the cards to add a friendly, human touch. The typography should be clean, modern, and highly readable, with a clear hierarchy between the reviewer name and the body text. The overall aesthetic is professional, trustworthy, and warm. Use generous whitespace between cards to ensure the layout feels airy and organized. The color palette should be neutral and soft, allowing the white cards to pop against the blurred background. The composition should feel organic and non-grid-like, mimicking a natural collage of positive feedback.

name: Floating Testimonial Cards
description: A visually engaging social proof section featuring layered testimonial cards with product imagery, perfect for building trust on e-commerce landing pages.
prompt: A high-quality landing page section design featuring a soft-focus, neutral-toned background. The layout is centered and vertical. At the top, a large, elegant serif headline [HEADLINE] sits above a smaller, handwritten-style sub-headline. Below this, arrange three distinct testimonial cards in a staggered vertical column. Each card is a dark, rounded-corner container with a soft drop shadow. Inside each card, include a five-star rating icon row, a customer name in bold sans-serif, and a paragraph of testimonial text. To the left of each card, place a small, circular or scalloped-edge cutout containing a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] that slightly overlaps the edge of the dark card for a layered, tactile effect. Use generous whitespace between cards to maintain a clean, premium aesthetic. The overall mood should be sophisticated, trustworthy, and modern. Ensure the typography is highly legible with a clear hierarchy between the headline, name, and body text. The color palette should be muted and professional, using dark charcoal or deep earth tones for the cards to contrast against the light, blurred background.

name: Floating Testimonial Showcase
description: A visually engaging layout featuring high-quality product photography paired with floating, card-based testimonials to build social proof.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist product showcase section. The background is a clean, neutral off-white or light grey surface with soft, natural lighting creating subtle, realistic shadows. Place two [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items at different angles, one slightly higher than the other, creating a dynamic, asymmetric composition. Overlay two clean, white, rounded-corner rectangular cards containing customer testimonials. Each card features a row of five gold-colored star icons at the top, followed by a short, impactful quote in a modern sans-serif font, and a small attribution line for the customer name. The cards should have a subtle drop shadow to create a 'floating' effect. The overall aesthetic is clean, professional, and airy, with generous whitespace. At the bottom center, include a small, subtle social media handle or brand tag in a minimalist font. The lighting should be bright and soft, emphasizing the texture and quality of the products. The design should feel premium and trustworthy, suitable for e-commerce or lifestyle brands. Ensure the typography is highly legible, using a balanced hierarchy between the quote and the attribution.

name: Floating Testimonial Cards
description: A clean, elegant social proof section featuring overlapping testimonial cards with a soft drop shadow, ideal for building trust on service or premium product pages.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist landing page section featuring a centered, large, elegant serif headline [HEADLINE] at the top. Below the headline, arrange three square testimonial cards in a slightly overlapping, staggered, floating layout. Each card should have rounded corners and a subtle, soft drop shadow to create depth. The cards should use a monochromatic or complementary color palette with high contrast between the background and text. Inside each card, include a row of five solid star icons at the top, followed by a paragraph of testimonial text, and a bottom-left circular avatar containing a single initial letter followed by the reviewer's name. The background of the entire section should be a soft, neutral off-white or cream color. The typography for the headline should be large, sophisticated, and italicized, while the body text inside the cards should be clean, legible, and sans-serif. The overall aesthetic should be professional, trustworthy, and airy, with generous whitespace surrounding the cards to ensure a premium feel. No clutter, focus on the floating card composition and elegant typography.

name: Floating Q&A Card
description: A centered, semi-transparent card overlaying a soft-focus background image, perfect for highlighting brand values or FAQs.

prompt: A high-end, professional landing page section featuring a central, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] held by a human hand in the center of the frame. The background is a deep, solid, rich-toned color that provides high contrast. Surrounding the central product are four distinct, clean, white rectangular testimonial cards floating at different depths and angles. Each card contains a 5-star rating icon, a user name, a bold review title, and a short body text snippet. The typography for the main [HEADLINE] at the top of the section is large, bold, and elegant, using a mix of sans-serif and sophisticated serif fonts. The overall visual hierarchy places the product as the primary focal point, with the testimonial cards acting as secondary supporting elements that draw the eye inward. Use generous whitespace between the floating cards to ensure readability. The lighting should be soft and studio-quality, highlighting the texture of the product and the hand. The aesthetic is premium, trustworthy, and modern, suitable for luxury or high-performance consumer goods.

name: Framed Testimonial Showcase
description: A high-impact social proof section featuring a large, framed product-in-hand image overlaid with a testimonial card, perfect for building trust.
prompt: A professional landing page section design. The background is a solid, deep, rich matte color. In the top left, a large, elegant, serif-font headline [HEADLINE] is placed. The central focal point is a high-quality, realistic photograph of a hand holding [PRODUCT_IMAGE], framed by a clean, white, thin-lined square border that is open at the top. Inside the bottom portion of this frame, a rounded-corner white card contains a customer testimonial. The card includes a small circular avatar, a customer name, a 'Verified Purchase' badge, five gold star icons, and a block of text. To the right of the frame, the [BRAND_NAME] is written vertically in a clean, minimalist sans-serif font. The overall composition is balanced, sophisticated, and modern. Use generous whitespace around the central frame to ensure the product and testimonial are the clear focus. The lighting on the product should be soft and natural, emphasizing texture and quality. The design should feel premium, trustworthy, and clean, suitable for high-end e-commerce.

name: Conversational Social Proof
description: A simulated chat interface section used to build trust through authentic-feeling peer-to-peer recommendations.
prompt: A high-fidelity UI design of a mobile messaging interface section. The layout features a dark background with a vertical chat flow. On the left, display circular user avatars with a small profile image placeholder. Next to the avatars, place grey-colored chat bubbles containing text from a peer. On the right, place vibrant, colored chat bubbles (e.g., purple or blue) containing the response text. The typography should be clean, sans-serif, and legible, mimicking a modern messaging app. Include a top navigation bar with a contact name, a back arrow, and phone/video call icons. At the bottom, include a fixed input field with a camera icon, a text placeholder, a microphone icon, an image icon, and an emoji icon. The visual hierarchy should prioritize the chat bubbles, using color contrast to distinguish between the sender and the receiver. The overall mood is casual, intimate, and trustworthy, designed to look like a real conversation between two people discussing [PRODUCT_IMAGE] and [BRAND_NAME]. Ensure the spacing between bubbles is consistent to maintain a natural reading rhythm. The design should be minimalist, focusing entirely on the text content as the primary conversion driver.

name: Floating Testimonial Showcase

name: Conversational Social Proof
description: A chat-interface style testimonial section that mimics real-time messaging to build authentic trust and social proof.
prompt: A high-fidelity UI design of a mobile messaging interface used as a social proof section on a landing page. The layout features a vertical chat stream with alternating message bubbles. The left-aligned bubbles represent the customer, using a light grey background with dark text, while the right-aligned bubbles represent the brand, using a soft primary brand color background with white text. Include realistic UI elements like timestamps, double-check marks for read receipts, and a voice note waveform component. The typography should be clean, sans-serif, and highly readable. The background of the section should be a subtle, light-colored pattern or a clean off-white to keep focus on the conversation. The visual hierarchy prioritizes the emotional, positive feedback from the customer. Use [HEADLINE] as a title above the chat window. The overall mood is intimate, authentic, and trustworthy. Ensure generous vertical spacing between message groups to maintain clarity. The design should feel like a genuine screenshot of a private conversation, emphasizing the human connection between [BRAND_NAME] and their satisfied user.

name: Conversational FAQ Chat
description: A stylized chat-interface section that presents FAQs as a dialogue between a user and a brand, perfect for humanizing support content.
prompt: A high-fidelity UI design of a conversational chat interface overlaid on a soft-focus, lifestyle background image. The layout features a vertical sequence of chat bubbles arranged in an alternating pattern. User messages are placed on the left with a small circular avatar, while brand responses are placed on the right with a brand logo icon. Each message bubble is a rounded, soft-cornered rectangle with a subtle drop shadow, using a light cream or off-white background color. The typography is clean, modern, and highly legible, with a distinct visual hierarchy between the sender label (small, uppercase, light weight) and the message body (larger, medium weight). The background image should be a warm, inviting lifestyle shot that remains visible through the gaps between bubbles. Use generous vertical whitespace between message pairs to ensure readability. The overall aesthetic is friendly, approachable, and minimalist. Include placeholders for [USER_AVATAR], [BRAND_LOGO], and [MESSAGE_TEXT]. The color palette should be neutral and calming, focusing on high contrast between the text and the bubble background. Ensure the design feels like a premium mobile messaging app experience adapted for a desktop landing page.

name: Floating Testimonial Overlay
description: A high-conversion social proof section featuring customer testimonials in speech-bubble style cards layered over a human-centric background image.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page section featuring a centered, soft-focus portrait of a person as the background image. Overlaid on this image are two distinct, rounded rectangular speech-bubble cards with a solid, high-contrast pastel background color. Each card contains a customer name, a five-star rating icon in a vibrant accent color, and a paragraph of testimonial text. The speech bubbles should have a small triangular pointer at the bottom or side to mimic a chat interface. The typography should be clean, modern, and highly legible with generous line spacing. The overall visual hierarchy places the testimonial text as the primary focal point, with the background image providing emotional context. Use a soft, warm, or neutral color palette for the background and a bold, solid color for the speech bubbles to ensure maximum readability. Include a subtle, vertical text label on the far right edge of the section indicating 'Verified Reviews'. The design should feel organic, trustworthy, and human-centric, suitable for any brand looking to build social proof through authentic customer feedback.

name: Elegant Testimonial Card
description: A sophisticated, centered testimonial section featuring a soft, textured background and a clean, floating card design, perfect for building trust in luxury or lifestyle brands.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist testimonial section design. The background is a soft, elegant, light-colored silk or satin fabric texture with subtle folds and gentle lighting. In the center, place a large, clean, white rounded-corner card with a soft drop shadow. At the top of the section, display a [HEADLINE] in a sophisticated, flowing script font, followed by a row of five solid, warm-toned star icons. Inside the central white card, place a large, centered block of text representing the [TESTIMONIAL_CONTENT] in a clean, readable sans-serif font. Use large, stylized quotation marks in a muted, earthy tone at the top-left and bottom-right corners of the text block. Below the text, include a small, pill-shaped badge in a soft, neutral color containing the [CUSTOMER_NAME]. The overall aesthetic should be premium, airy, and trustworthy, with generous whitespace and a balanced, symmetrical layout. The color palette should be monochromatic with warm, muted accent tones for the stars and name badge. High resolution, professional UI design style.

name: Minimalist Circular Testimonial
description: A clean, centered testimonial card featuring a circular container, perfect for building trust with elegant, lifestyle-focused branding.
prompt: A high-quality, minimalist web design section featuring a centered circular white card against a soft, neutral-toned background with subtle organic botanical elements in the corner. Inside the circle, place a bold, elegant serif heading [HEADLINE] at the top, followed by a row of five solid, muted-gold star icons. Below the stars, display a customer testimonial quote in a clean, readable sans-serif font. At the bottom of the circle, include the customer name in a small, uppercase, letter-spaced sans-serif font. The overall aesthetic should be sophisticated, airy, and premium. Use ample whitespace around the circular container to ensure focus. The background should have a soft, warm, matte texture. The typography should be high-contrast, using a dark charcoal or black for text to ensure readability against the white circle. The design should feel balanced, symmetrical, and professional, suitable for a high-end lifestyle or beauty brand.

name: Vertical Testimonial Stack
description: A clean, vertically aligned testimonial section featuring speech-bubble cards, ideal for building trust and social proof on landing pages.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page section for social proof. The layout is a single-column vertical stack centered on a light, textured, off-white paper-like background. At the top, a large, elegant handwritten-style script font displays the [HEADLINE], followed by a prominent five-star rating icon in a solid dark-toned rounded rectangle. Below this, three identical testimonial cards are stacked vertically with generous spacing. Each card is a dark, muted-tone rounded rectangle with a speech-bubble tail pointing to the bottom-left. Inside each card, place large, stylized quotation marks at the top-left and bottom-right corners. The text inside the cards is clean, legible, and centered, representing [TESTIMONIAL_CONTENT]. The overall aesthetic is minimalist, organic, and trustworthy, using a color palette of muted earth tones, deep forest greens, and soft cream backgrounds. Ensure high contrast between the dark cards and the light background. The design should feel modern, approachable, and premium, suitable for any brand looking to showcase customer feedback.

name: Floating Testimonial Collage
description: A dynamic social proof section featuring floating review cards surrounding a central image of a hand holding a smartphone, perfect for building trust through user-generated content.
prompt: A high-quality landing page section design. The background is a soft, warm, solid neutral color with subtle circular gradient depth. At the center-right, a realistic high-resolution image of a hand holding a modern smartphone displaying [PRODUCT_IMAGE] on its screen. Surrounding the phone are multiple clean, white, rounded-corner floating testimonial cards arranged in an asymmetric, organic layout. Each card features a user avatar, a 5-star rating, and a text review. The typography is clean, modern, and highly legible. At the top left, a large, bold, elegant headline [HEADLINE] is displayed, accompanied by a large, stylized quotation mark icon in a slightly darker shade than the background. The overall visual hierarchy emphasizes the social proof cards and the product-in-hand image. The lighting is soft and professional, creating a clean, trustworthy, and premium aesthetic. Use generous whitespace between elements to ensure the layout feels airy and uncluttered. The style should be minimalist, professional, and conversion-focused, suitable for any e-commerce brand.

name: Floating Speech Bubble Testimonials
description: A social proof section featuring staggered, speech-bubble style testimonial cards overlaid on a blurred background, perfect for building trust.
prompt: A high-quality landing page testimonial section. The background is a soft, out-of-focus, blurred lifestyle image that provides a warm, human context. Overlaid on this background are two distinct, staggered speech-bubble shaped cards with a soft pastel yellow background color. Each card contains a customer name in a bold, clean sans-serif font, followed by a row of five bright gold star icons, and then the testimonial text in a readable, medium-weight sans-serif font. The speech bubbles have a triangular pointer tail extending from the bottom corner of each card. The layout is asymmetric, with one card positioned higher on the left and the second card positioned lower on the right to create visual interest. At the very bottom of the section, centered, is a small, subtle text line indicating the source of the reviews. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and trustworthy, with generous whitespace within the cards and high contrast between the dark text and the light background cards. Use placeholders for [CUSTOMER_NAME] and [TESTIMONIAL_TEXT]. The design should feel approachable and authentic.

name: Organic Testimonial Stack
description: A sophisticated, soft-toned testimonial section featuring staggered cards with organic-shaped profile images, ideal for lifestyle and premium brands.
prompt: A high-end, minimalist testimonial section design. The background is a soft, warm neutral beige with a subtle, out-of-focus palm leaf shadow overlay to create depth. At the top, a centered, elegant serif [HEADLINE] in dark charcoal. Below, a vertical stack of three white, rounded-corner rectangular cards. Each card contains a customer name in a delicate script font, a five-star rating in a muted gold color, and a short text review in a clean, readable serif font. Each card features a unique, organic-shaped (blob-like) portrait photo of the reviewer, positioned partially overlapping the edge of the card. A small, subtle 'E' icon badge is placed in the corner of each card for visual interest. The layout is clean with generous whitespace between cards. The overall mood is serene, professional, and high-quality. Use soft lighting, high-end editorial photography style for the portraits, and a balanced, airy composition. The bottom of the section features a small, spaced-out sans-serif brand signature.

name: Centered Testimonial Card
description: A high-contrast, centered testimonial card featuring a large quote icon, star rating, and brand attribution, perfect for building trust on landing pages.
prompt: A clean, professional testimonial section design. The layout features a vibrant, solid-colored background with a large, centered white card container with soft rounded corners. Inside the card, at the top, place a large, bold, stylized quote mark icon in a contrasting accent color. Below the quote, include a row of five solid gold star icons. Centered below the stars, display the [HEADLINE] text in a clean, readable sans-serif font, using a medium weight. Below the text, place the reviewer's name in a bold font, followed by a smaller, lighter date stamp. At the bottom of the card, include a small, centered circular logo placeholder for [BRAND_NAME]. The overall visual hierarchy should be vertical and symmetrical. Use generous whitespace inside the card to ensure readability. The background color should be a bold, saturated hue, while the card remains crisp white to create a strong visual pop. The style should be modern, minimalist, and trustworthy, suitable for any professional service or e-commerce site.

name: Clean Grid Testimonials
description: A structured, multi-column testimonial grid featuring individual cards with user avatars, ratings, and quotes, perfect for building social proof.
prompt: A professional, clean landing page section displaying a grid of customer testimonials. The layout features a centered section header with a small sub-headline above a larger main headline [HEADLINE]. Below the header, arrange a 2x4 grid of individual testimonial cards. Each card should have a soft, light-gray background with rounded corners and a subtle drop shadow. Inside each card, place a circular user avatar on the left, followed by the user's name and job title in bold, a 5-star rating icon row, and a large quote mark icon in the top right corner. Below the header info, include a multi-line text block for the testimonial quote. The overall aesthetic should be minimalist and corporate-friendly, using ample whitespace between cards. At the bottom of the grid, include a centered, pill-shaped 'Load More' button in a high-contrast brand color. Use a clean, sans-serif typography hierarchy. The background should be clean white or very light gray to ensure the cards pop. The design should feel organized, trustworthy, and easy to scan, suitable for any professional service or product brand.

name: Step-by-Step Process Grid
description: A clean, instructional grid layout featuring circular icons and descriptive text, perfect for explaining product usage or service workflows.
prompt: A high-quality, minimalist instructional section for a landing page. The layout features a centered, bold [HEADLINE] at the top. Below the headline, create a symmetrical 2x2 grid of four distinct content blocks. Each block consists of a large, thin-lined circular icon container with a centered, minimalist line-art illustration representing a specific step. Below each icon, place a bold, colored sub-headline (e.g., 'Step 1') followed by two lines of concise, readable body text. The design should use a soft, solid pastel background color. The icons and text should use a consistent, high-contrast brand color. Ensure generous whitespace between the grid items to maintain a clean, uncluttered look. The typography should be modern, sans-serif, and highly legible. The overall aesthetic is professional, friendly, and easy to follow, suitable for any industry explaining a process or guide. No shadows, flat design style, vector-like clarity.

name: Educational Tip Collage
description: A dynamic, scrapbook-style layout featuring alternating images and handwritten-style tips, perfect for educational content or product usage guides.
prompt: A high-quality, editorial-style landing page section featuring a 'scrapbook' or 'collage' layout. The background is a solid, textured matte color. The layout consists of three distinct content blocks arranged in an asymmetric, staggered grid. Each block contains a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] framed with a slight white border and a subtle drop shadow to look like a physical photograph. Next to each image, place a 'tip' card: a white rectangular paper-cutout style label with a bold sans-serif header like 'Tip #1', followed by a paragraph of friendly, handwritten-style typography. Use hand-drawn doodle elements like arrows, circles, or weather icons connecting the text to the images to create a playful, organic feel. The overall visual hierarchy should guide the eye in a zig-zag pattern down the page. Include a prominent, pill-shaped call-to-action button at the bottom with a clear icon and text [HEADLINE]. The aesthetic should be approachable, authentic, and lifestyle-focused, avoiding overly corporate or sterile design. Use generous whitespace between elements to maintain readability. The color palette should be cohesive, using a muted primary background color with high-contrast white text and accents.

name: Circular Process Grid
description: A visually engaging four-quadrant grid arranged in a circular flow, perfect for showcasing step-by-step routines or multi-part product systems.
prompt: A high-quality, clean landing page section featuring a central circular layout divided into four equal quadrants. The background is a soft, ethereal gradient blending light pastel tones like pale pink and soft blue, with subtle light flares and bokeh effects to create a premium, airy atmosphere. In the center, place a large, faint circular path with a subtle arrow indicating a clockwise flow. Each of the four quadrants contains a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] placed slightly off-center to maintain balance. Behind each product, display a large, semi-transparent, bold number (1, 2, 3, 4) to denote the sequence. Below each product, include a clean, sans-serif text block for [HEADLINE] and a short description. At the top of the section, place a prominent, elegant title using a mix of script and bold sans-serif typography. The overall visual hierarchy should guide the eye in a circular motion. Use generous whitespace between quadrants to ensure clarity. The style should be modern, minimalist, and professional, suitable for beauty, wellness, or instructional product kits. Ensure the lighting on the products is soft and studio-quality, with subtle drop shadows to lift them from the background.

name: Hand-Drawn Step-by-Step
description: A playful, scrapbook-style instructional section that uses hand-drawn elements and photo collages to guide users through a process.
prompt: A high-quality, editorial-style instructional landing page section with a scrapbook aesthetic. The background is a soft, textured paper or light pastel solid color. The layout features three distinct steps arranged in an asymmetric, organic flow. Each step includes a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or lifestyle photo placed within a slightly tilted, white-bordered frame that looks like a physical polaroid or print. Surrounding each photo are hand-drawn, loose, circular or oval outlines in a contrasting ink color. Use a playful, handwritten-style font for the [HEADLINE] at the top and for the step descriptions. Include small, whimsical hand-drawn doodles like arrows, hearts, or stars to connect the steps and guide the eye. The visual hierarchy is clear: the headline is the largest element, followed by the step numbers, then the descriptive text. The overall mood is approachable, youthful, and authentic. Ensure ample whitespace between elements to maintain a clean, non-cluttered look. The color palette should be soft and cohesive, using a primary brand color for the hand-drawn elements and text, set against a neutral, light-toned background.

name: Collage Editorial Hero
description: A dynamic, layered editorial-style hero section that combines a central human subject with floating product cutouts and paper-texture elements, perfect for lifestyle and beauty brands.
prompt: A high-end editorial landing page hero section featuring a central, high-resolution portrait of a person interacting with a product, set against a soft, neutral-toned background. The composition is a creative collage: place [PRODUCT_IMAGE] cutouts floating around the central subject, some partially tucked behind paper-texture scraps or polaroid-style frames. Include a prominent [HEADLINE] in a sophisticated, high-contrast serif typeface, positioned to balance the visual weight of the product images. Use a mix of clean, modern sans-serif for sub-headlines and elegant serif for the main title. Incorporate subtle design elements like paper clips, torn paper edges, and soft drop shadows to create a tactile, layered depth. The color palette should be muted and sophisticated, allowing the product colors to pop. Ensure the layout feels organic yet structured, with ample whitespace around the edges to maintain a premium feel. The overall mood is aspirational, clean, and professional. The lighting should be soft and flattering, emphasizing the texture of the products and the subject's skin. High-quality, commercial photography style, 8k resolution, sharp focus on the central subject with a slight depth-of-field blur on background elements.

name: Sequential Process Flow
description: A step-by-step instructional layout using staggered polaroid-style frames and hand-drawn arrows, perfect for tutorials or product usage guides.
prompt: A high-quality landing page section featuring a 'how-to' process flow. The background is a soft, light-colored paper texture with subtle horizontal lines. Arrange four [PRODUCT_IMAGE] frames in a staggered, zig-zag pattern down the page. Each image is styled as a tilted polaroid photo with a white border and a drop shadow. Below each photo, include a 'step #X:' label in a playful, handwritten-style font. Next to each photo, place a white rectangular text box containing [HEADLINE] text in a clean, sans-serif font. Connect the steps using hand-drawn, whimsical purple arrows that guide the eye from one step to the next in a logical sequence. The overall aesthetic is friendly, approachable, and educational. Use a consistent color palette of soft pastels for the background and a bold, contrasting color for the arrows and text to ensure readability. The layout should feel organic and scrapbook-inspired, with generous whitespace between elements to maintain clarity. High resolution, professional photography style for the product images, clean vector-style graphics for the arrows and text boxes.

name: Premium Product Showcase
description: A modular, high-end product showcase section featuring a mix of hero imagery, lifestyle usage shots, and feature-focused callouts, ideal for premium consumer electronics or lifestyle goods.
prompt: A high-end, professional product landing page section designed for a premium brand. The layout is a modular grid system. Top section: A large, full-width hero area with a dark, moody gradient background, featuring a high-resolution [PRODUCT_IMAGE] centered, with [HEADLINE] in bold, clean sans-serif typography on the left and a short descriptive paragraph on the right. Middle section: A four-column grid of lifestyle images showing the product in use, each with a small, subtle icon overlay and a caption box containing a feature title and short description. Bottom section: A split-layout row featuring a high-action product shot on the left (e.g., water splash or motion) and a clean, white-background card on the right containing a feature highlight, a bold title, and a technical specification badge. The overall aesthetic is sleek, modern, and minimalist. Use a deep, rich color palette (e.g., dark forest green or charcoal) with high-contrast white text. Include subtle drop shadows, rounded corners on cards, and generous whitespace to maintain a premium feel. The lighting should be studio-quality, highlighting the textures and materials of the [PRODUCT_IMAGE].

name: Annotated Product Callout
description: A feature-focused section using a central product image with connected callout bubbles to explain multiple use cases or benefits.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] centered on the left side of the frame. The background is a soft, light gradient. On the right side, create a vertical sequence of four small circular inset images, each showing a different use case or feature of the product. Connect these circular insets to the main product image using a subtle, thin dotted line that curves gracefully. Next to each circular inset, place a small blue plus icon followed by a bold, concise text label describing the feature. The main headline [HEADLINE] is positioned in the top left, using a large, bold, sans-serif font in a dark navy color. The overall visual hierarchy prioritizes the main product image, then the headline, then the annotated feature list. Use generous white space to ensure the layout feels airy and modern. The style should be minimalist, clinical, and trustworthy, suitable for health, wellness, or tech products. Ensure the typography is clean and legible, with high contrast between the dark text and the light background.

name: Step-by-Step Product Flow
description: A sequential product showcase layout that guides the user through a multi-step process using floating product imagery and clear, numbered callouts.
prompt: A high-quality, clean landing page section featuring a sequential product flow. The background is a soft, solid pastel color. The layout is asymmetric and organic, featuring three distinct [PRODUCT_IMAGE] items placed at different heights and positions (top right, middle left, bottom right). Each product is accompanied by a 'Step' indicator: a small, bold, rounded-corner pill-shaped badge containing the text 'STEP X' in a high-contrast color, connected to the product by a thin, clean horizontal line. Next to each step badge, include a clear, bold title for the product and a secondary line of descriptive text. The main headline [HEADLINE] is positioned at the top left in a large, bold, sans-serif font. The overall visual hierarchy should prioritize the flow from step 1 to step 3. Use generous whitespace to ensure the products feel 'floating' and premium. The style should be modern, minimalist, and professional, suitable for skincare or wellness brands. Ensure the lighting on the products is soft and studio-quality, with subtle drop shadows to create depth against the background. The typography should be clean, modern, and highly legible.

name: Step-by-Step Infographic Grid
description: A structured, multi-step instructional infographic section perfect for explaining routines, processes, or how-to guides in a visually engaging, easy-to-digest format.
prompt: A high-quality, flat-design infographic section layout. The background is a solid, calming muted color. At the top, a centered [HEADLINE] in a clean, elegant sans-serif font, with a smaller sub-headline above it. Below, a 2x3 grid of six identical rounded-corner cards. Each card has a soft, light-colored background that contrasts slightly with the main background. Inside each card, place a numbered circle in the top-left corner. Below the number, include a central, high-quality illustrative icon or simple graphic representing a step in a process. Under the graphic, place a bold, uppercase title for the step, followed by two lines of descriptive body text. At the bottom of each card, include a small, pill-shaped badge with a short, punchy action-oriented phrase. The overall aesthetic is clean, professional, and organized. Use subtle decorative botanical or geometric elements in the corners of the main section to add visual interest. The color palette should be harmonious, using a monochromatic or analogous scheme with high readability for text. Ensure generous whitespace between cards and consistent alignment throughout the grid. The style should feel approachable, educational, and modern, suitable for a brand-focused instructional guide.

name: Central Hub Infographic
description: A radial infographic layout featuring a central focal point connected to surrounding descriptive points, ideal for problem-agitation or feature-breakdown sections.
prompt: A clean, professional radial infographic design on a solid soft-toned background. In the exact center, place a prominent [PRODUCT_IMAGE] inside a circular frame. Radiating outward from the center are five distinct circular icons, each connected to the central image by a thin, straight line. Below each of the five outer icons, place a short, concise text label [HEADLINE]. The layout should be balanced and symmetrical, using a soft pastel color palette with a darker, high-contrast color for the text and connecting lines to ensure readability. The typography should be a clean, modern sans-serif font with a clear hierarchy: a large, bold title at the top of the section and smaller, legible text for the labels. The overall aesthetic should be educational, minimalist, and easy to digest. Use generous whitespace between the outer circles to prevent clutter. The style should be flat vector illustration, professional, and suitable for a high-conversion landing page.

name: Circular Process Flow
description: A visual step-by-step guide arranged in a circular path, perfect for explaining complex workflows or product usage instructions.
prompt: A clean, professional landing page section featuring a circular process flow diagram. In the center of the composition, leave ample negative space. Arrange five circular image frames [PRODUCT_IMAGE] in a large circle around the center. Each circular frame should have a thick, solid-colored border. Between each circle, place a bold, curved arrow pointing clockwise to indicate the sequence of steps. Next to each circular frame, place a short, clear text label [HEADLINE] describing the step. In the top right corner, place a large, prominent '5 Steps' badge with bold typography. The background should be a subtle, light-textured neutral color to provide depth without distraction. The overall visual hierarchy should guide the eye in a clockwise motion. Use a consistent, high-contrast color palette for the borders, arrows, and text. The style should be modern, instructional, and minimalist, suitable for a professional brand. Ensure the layout is balanced and symmetrical, with generous whitespace between elements to maintain readability. The design should feel educational and easy to follow, suitable for any industry explaining a multi-step process.

name: Educational Step-by-Step Grid
description: A visually engaging, multi-step instructional layout that combines lifestyle imagery with numbered tips, perfect for educational content or product usage guides.
prompt: A high-quality, professional landing page section featuring a soft, warm, and inviting aesthetic. The layout is organized as a structured educational guide. At the top, a prominent [HEADLINE] is displayed in a elegant, bold serif font, set against a subtle, textured, light-toned background with soft organic leaf illustrations. Below the headline, create a staggered grid of four distinct content blocks. Each block is contained within a soft-edged, rounded rectangular card with a subtle drop shadow. Each card must feature a large, circular or rounded-square numbered badge (1, 2, 3, 4) in a warm accent color. Inside each card, place a high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or lifestyle photo showing the step in action, paired with a concise, readable paragraph of text. Use a clean, sans-serif font for the body text. The overall color palette should be warm, using soft creams, muted terracottas, and gentle earth tones. Include small, decorative sparkles or botanical icons scattered lightly to add a premium, friendly feel. The composition should feel balanced, airy, and easy to scan, with generous whitespace between the cards to ensure clarity. The style should be modern, approachable, and highly polished, suitable for a lifestyle or wellness brand.

name: Annotated Product Showcase
description: A high-impact visual section that uses hand-drawn style annotations to highlight specific features or benefits directly on a high-quality product-in-use image.
prompt: A high-resolution, professional lifestyle photography shot featuring [PRODUCT_IMAGE] in use by a person, centered or slightly off-center to allow for negative space. The image should have a clean, soft-focus background to ensure the subject pops. Overlay the image with elegant, thin, hand-drawn style white vector arrows and lines that point to specific areas of the product or the effect it has on the subject. Next to these arrows, place clean, minimalist sans-serif text labels describing the benefits, such as [HEADLINE]. The typography should be small, legible, and airy, using a high-contrast white color against the skin or product tones. The overall aesthetic is educational, premium, and instructional. Include a subtle, elegant brand logo at the bottom center. The lighting should be natural and soft, emphasizing the texture of the product and the subject. The composition must feel organic, not cluttered, with plenty of breathing room between the annotation lines. The mood is sophisticated, trustworthy, and informative, suitable for high-end beauty, wellness, or technical hardware products.

name: Educational Step-by-Step Grid
description: A structured 2x3 grid layout designed for educational content, tutorials, or 'how-to' guides, featuring numbered cards with integrated imagery and bulleted advice.
prompt: A high-conversion educational landing page section featuring a clean 2x3 grid layout. At the top, a bold, centered [HEADLINE] in a modern sans-serif font, followed by a descriptive sub-headline. Below, six uniform rectangular cards arranged in two columns. Each card features a large, high-quality [PRODUCT_IMAGE] or relevant lifestyle photo at the top half, with a prominent, large, bold number (1-6) in the top-left corner of the card. The bottom half of each card contains a concise title and three bullet points of actionable advice, accompanied by a small, minimalist icon for each point. The cards have rounded corners, a subtle drop shadow, and a soft, professional color palette with high contrast between text and background. The overall aesthetic is clean, clinical, and trustworthy, using ample whitespace between cards to ensure readability. The background is a soft, neutral gradient or solid light color to keep the focus on the content. The design should feel organized, authoritative, and easy to scan, suitable for any industry providing expert guidance or product usage instructions.

name: Instructional Process Grid
description: A structured 2x2 or 3x2 grid layout designed to visually explain a multi-step process or tutorial using high-quality imagery and concise text labels.
prompt: A clean, professional instructional landing page section featuring a 2x2 grid layout. At the top, center-aligned, place a large [HEADLINE] in a sophisticated serif font, followed by a smaller, italicized sub-headline. Below this, create a symmetrical grid of four high-quality, evenly spaced image containers. Each image container should feature a [PRODUCT_IMAGE] demonstrating a specific step of a process. Directly above or below each image, place a clear, concise text label describing the step in a clean sans-serif typeface. The background should be a soft, neutral, monochromatic tone (like light beige or off-white) to ensure high readability. Use generous whitespace between grid items to maintain a minimalist, premium aesthetic. The overall visual hierarchy should prioritize the images as the primary focal points, with the text acting as a secondary guide. The style should be elegant, airy, and educational, suitable for beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brands. Ensure the lighting in the images is soft and natural, creating a cohesive, high-end look across all four quadrants. Include a final, short, impactful call-to-action or summary sentence at the very bottom, centered, to conclude the section.

name: Circular Step Grid
description: A clean, instructional four-step grid layout using circular imagery to guide users through a process or usage guide.
prompt: A high-quality, minimalist instructional landing page section featuring a 2x2 grid layout. Each of the four quadrants contains a large, perfectly circular image placeholder [PRODUCT_IMAGE] showing a specific step in a process.
